item.title: Jason’s Friends Assisting over 180 Wyoming Families as 28th Annual Bowl Fundraiser Approaches

item.title: Natrona County man with dog training business pleads to animal cruelty charge
item.description: CASPER, Wyo. — A Natrona Country man pleaded guilty on Wednesday to a misdemeanor charge of cruelty to animals after a dog he boarded died from blunt force trauma and injuries including a fractured skull.
